title: Deduplicate near-identical CurriculumLabels test coverage spread across 3 test files

evidence.quote: test('excludes level labels when includeLevelLabel is false', () {
test('daily targets exist for all curricula', () {

why: curriculum_defaults_extended_test.dart and curriculum_labels_extended_test.dart both independently claim in their file-header doc comments to cover 'methods not yet tested' by the other files, but in fact both re-test CurriculumLabels.container, .containerSectionHeader, .level (RangeError for 0 and out-of-range), .valueWithLabel, and .fullPath (skip-null, custom-separator, includeLevelLabel=false) with near-identical test names and assertions — e.g. the 'excludes level labels' group exists verbatim in both files. curriculum_defaults_test.dart separately duplicates the CurriculumDefaults.defaultStages/defaultDailyTargets assertions that curriculum_defaults_extended_test.dart's last group re-covers. Net effect: ~1200 lines across 4 files test one 1270-line source file, with the same behavior asserted 2-3x under different names — any future change to e.g. fullPath's separator handling requires hunting through multiple files to update every duplicate, and CI burns time re-running equivalent assertions. (curriculum_label_variant_test.dart, the 4th file, was checked and found NOT to overlap — it covers distinct nusach/transliteration behavior only.)
recommendation: Consolidate curriculum_defaults_extended_test.dart and curriculum_labels_extended_test.dart (partition cleanly by class — LevelLabels vs CurriculumLabels vs CurriculumDefaults — or merge into curriculum_defaults_test.dart), removing the 5+ duplicate assertion groups identified.
acceptance_criteria: No two test groups across the constants test directory assert the same production method+scenario combination
Consolidated suite's total line count is measurably smaller than the current 4-file total

corrections: None needed — all cited evidence and derived counts verified accurate.
